title: Equal flag vectors and different codimension-three face counts for polytopal order polytopes

creators.name: Zuo, Bowen
creators.affiliation: East China University of Science and Technology

description: Two three-polytopes with the full flag vector (1,7,12,7,24,24,24,48) have order polytopes with 35,946 and 35,944 faces of dimension 25. Original software is available under Apache-2.0. The paper carries a separate copyright notice.
